verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows conceptual docs, markdown and llms.txt access, and GitHub demo apps such as the Serverless Meeting Demo. None of it documents an interactive API reference with runnable in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Sample applications are an adjacent resource, not the interactive reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
